findings.claim: No test stores a duplicated tag inside one task, so the 'a task counts once per tag' rule of AC-3 is unchecked.
findings.failure_scenario: Remove the set() in task_stats (for name in task.get('tags', [])); a task tagged ["a","a"] then counts twice for #a, and every test in test_stats.py still passes.

findings.claim: Only the due-before-priority order is tested; due-before-tags and tags-before-priority, which AC-6 also fixes, are not.
findings.failure_scenario: Change cmd_stats so bad_tags runs before the due loop, or bad_priority before bad_tags. With open task 1 tagged "x" and task 2 having a bad due date (or task 1 having a bad priority and task 2 bad tags), the error names the wrong task, and all tests still pass.
